dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Continuous and smooth narrowing of the 2D lateral profile from the widest mid-body section toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Generally smooth and convex lateral margins with a subtle asymmetrical indentation visible on the lower right margin prior to the peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; uniform high-intensity pixel distribution across the visible dorsal area.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple fine, linear, intersecting high-contrast marks consistent with superficial rake marks on the mid-dorsal and right-lateral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Superficial linear scarring or rake marks distributed across the posterior half of the visible dorsal plane.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast, dark circular blowhole aperture located on the anterior dorsal midline.
